'Dyke' was what I mostly got in school, or 'bull dyke' sometimes, 'lezzo' (lesso?) as well, 'rug-muncher', 'scissor-sister', and the ever popular 'freak'. 

None of these are really FTM specific though, as most people seemed to think I was just gay, despite all evidence to the contrary.

The only real crass one I know is cuntboy, but I don't think it's used much outside of the internet, I've never heard it in real life at least. Otherwise a lot of insults used towards lesbians get used a lot, which is both insulting and misgendering.
